summary: Strive, Inc. filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to disclose routine bitcoin purchases and updates to its cash, bitcoin holdings, and outstanding shares. From June 15-21, 2026, it bought 759 bitcoin at ~$65,850 each. The filing is a periodic portfolio disclosure, not a special situation transaction. No board recommendation, advisor, or structural deal terms are involved. This is an ordinary operational update with no event-driven catalyst or risk-arb angle.
